text:
Alex: Morning — quick async. What I did: deployed debounce change for alert-router (canary in us-west-2) and bumped grouping window. Verified basic flow.

Maria: Saw the canary alerts, looks cleaner. Did: added a temporary 5m dedupe rule to alertmanager to reduce noise.

Alex: Blocker: still seeing occasional duplicate pages when a short burst hits multiple routes (~8-12 duplicates/min). suspect race in route dedupe cache TTL.

Jamal: Oncall follow-up: paging history attached to incident 2021-0615. Victor handled the first wave. We need to add a runbook step for quick suppress.

Casey: FYI PR ping — #3721 (kafka backoff + alert-router consumer) is blocking the full rollout. Can someone review? @Alex @Maria :eyes:

Maria: I'll take a look now. Heads-up: I flagged one potential nil pointer in consumer backoff logic.

sre-bot: Canary deploy succeeded in us-west-2 :white_check_mark: (2109999245)

Sophie: Noted — SLOs: token-gen p99 latency burn ticked up overnight, error budget went 0.6% -> 1.1%. Not critical yet but trending. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/token-gen-burn

Alex: If burn crosses 1.5% we flip the mitigations in runbook (rate-limit + degrade model to v1.8). I'll prep that patch after debounce root cause.

Maria: quick config snippet I used for temporary suppression: 
```yaml
route: 
  receiver: team-pager
  group_by: ['alertname', 'cluster']
  repeat_interval: 5m
```
Will remove once root cause fixed.

Casey: PR #3721 updated per Maria's comment. @Maria can you re-approve when ready?

Maria: re-approved and added a small test. :thumbsup:

Jamal: Postmortem draft planned for tomorrow AM — needs alert counts and router logs for 04:10-05:30 UTC. @Sophie can you pull traces?

Sophie: On it, pulling perf traces + redis eviction logs for that window.

Alex: Oncall note — if you see duplicate alerts: check `route/alert-duplicates` metric, then the router logs: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/alert-router --tail=200 | grep duplicate`. Restarting the deployment is a last resort.

Casey: No blockers from infra side after PR merge. Will monitor post-rollout.

Maria: I'll follow up later with a short writeup on the TTL fix we think will stop the burst duplicates.

Alex: Great. Thanks all. Quick action items:
- Maria: land TTL patch + small test (EOD)
- Casey: merge PR #3721 after green CI
- Sophie: attach traces/logs to postmortem doc
- Jamal: draft postmortem, include incident timeline

Alex: End of async update. Ping here for anything urgent. :wave:
